_help: Keys starting with underscore are notes only. Run 'python sftp_load.py scan' to add every integration found in the samples folder, then fill upload_path (SFTP) or http_url (HTTP) for each.
_mode: functional = files written to disk, every upload checked on the server, 1 worker. performance = memory only, 4 workers, no per-file check. Override on the command line with --mode.
_total: Set a number (for example 20000) to spread that many files round robin over every selected integration. Leave null to use defaults.copies per integration.
_defaults: replace_last_n = how many digits the unique number has in file names. append_suffix goes after the number, before the extension. tag_value_length = digits written into replace_tags. http_form_field '' means a form part with an empty name (same as Postman/curl -F '=@file').
_batches: Each type runs its own stream: send batch_size files, wait batch_pause_seconds, repeat. Streams run side by side and share the workers.
_schedule: When present and enabled, replaces batch_size / batch_pause_seconds / type_run_settings / total / max_files_per_hour. Each hour is split into 60 random minute counts between min_per_minute and max_per_minute that add up to exactly that hour's total. per_hour: a number (same every hour), a list with one number per hour such as [15000, 20000, 15000] (hours is then optional), or null together with type_totals to spread the type totals evenly over the hours. type_totals: files per type for the whole run; the types are mixed evenly through every hour, and inside a type the integrations share round robin. If per_hour is also given, both must add up to the same number. Without type_totals, set per_hour (for example 15000). profile 'flat' = same count every minute. seed null = new pattern each run (the seed used is printed and written in the report); set a number to repeat a pattern. Files are spread across each minute and any shortfall is carried into the next minute. max_backlog null = hold back sending when files waiting for a worker exceed 2 x the busiest minute. Set enabled false (or delete the block) to go back to batch mode.
_failure_policy: Failed files never stop the run by themselves. If EVERY file fails continuously for warn_after_seconds an ERROR is logged and shown in the report; after abort_after_seconds (and at least min_failures files) the run stops, writes the report and exits with code 3. One success resets the timer. abort_after_seconds 0 = never stop, keep going until you press Ctrl+C.
_report: Above this many files the HTML report lists only the first rows of each integration (every failed file is always kept). The CSV manifest always has every row.
_tuning: null = use the mode preset (functional: 1 worker, disk, verify; performance: 4 workers, memory, no verify). max_files_per_hour is a hard throttle. end_check lists each remote folder once at the end of a performance run (poller may already have taken files). abort_after_consecutive_failures 0 = never abort.
_policy: Any SFTP upload_path outside required_prefix is skipped. prompt_before_prefix asks you to type YES before sending; use --yes to skip the prompt.
_run_filter: Empty = run everything. Examples: [{"type": "SFTP-SFTP", "slot": "5"}], [{"type": "SFTP-EMAIL", "slot": "all"}], [{"type": "HTTP-SFTP", "slot": ["1", "3"]}]. Or use --type and --slot on the command line.
